title: Members keep state between helpers
prompt: The robot's purse, a member `coins` at 0, grows through an `earn` helper and shrinks through a `spend` helper. coins_left earns 50, spends 20, earns 5 and reports 35.
hints: earn adds an amount to coins and spend subtracts one; both helpers work on the same member.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
